executiveSummary: A seed pitch for Larder, a meal-planning app that plans the week from what a family already has, cutting food waste by a third.

slides.slideTitle: Larder: plan the week from your fridge
slides.subtitle: Seed round · 2026
slides.speakerNotes: - Hi, I'm Sam, co-founder of Larder.

slides.slideTitle: A family of four throws away $1,500 of food a year
keyBullets: $1,500 a year per family of four
slides.speakerNotes: - That's the problem. Families waste a huge amount of food, and it's money in the bin.

slides.slideTitle: Grocery prices are up 25% in four years
slides.speakerNotes: - And groceries keep getting more expensive.

slides.slideTitle: There are hundreds of recipe apps
slides.speakerNotes: - There are lots of recipe apps out there.

slides.slideTitle: Larder has a barcode scanner for your pantry
slides.speakerNotes: - You can scan what you have with the barcode scanner, and it works offline.
- We support fourteen diets, so everyone in the family is covered.

slides.slideTitle: Our app won a design award this spring
keyBullets: Best New App, Mobile Design Awards 2026
slides.speakerNotes: - We're really proud of the design. It won Best New App this spring.

slides.slideTitle: Our team has 30 years of experience between us
keyBullets: Sam Okafor, CEO: 8 years in grocery retail
Lena Park, CTO: 12 years in mobile
slides.speakerNotes: - Our team has thirty years of combined experience in grocery, mobile, and design.
- We're raising one and a half million to fund eighteen months of engineering and growth.
